title: RxJS Small Examples
description: Use these small RxJS examples with the tools described in each lesson. Read the expected result before you try a change.

examples.title: Listen to a small stream
examples.description: An observable sends values to a subscriber.
examples.output: The console prints 2, then 4, then 6. This stream then completes.

examples.title: Transform each value
examples.description: map changes each emitted value into a new value.

examples.title: Keep values that pass a rule
examples.description: filter allows values through only when its test is true.

examples.title: Take only a few values
examples.description: take limits how many values a subscriber receives.
examples.output: The outputs are A and B, then the subscription completes.

examples.title: Watch a timed stream
examples.description: interval emits a growing count at a chosen time gap.
examples.output: About one second apart, the outputs are 0, 1 and 2, then it stops.

examples.title: Turn clicks into a stream
examples.description: fromEvent listens to events from a target.
examples.output: The first two clicks log Chosen. The stream then stops listening.

examples.title: Stop listening when finished
examples.description: A subscription has an unsubscribe method.
examples.output: Normally 0 and 1 appear before the subscription is stopped around 2.5 seconds.

examples.title: Send values with a Subject
examples.description: A Subject is both something you can subscribe to and something you can send values into.
examples.output: Both current subscribers receive Moon Trip.

examples.title: Keep the latest value
examples.description: A BehaviorSubject starts with one value and gives the latest value to each new subscriber.

examples.title: Combine the latest values
examples.description: combineLatest waits until each input has a value, then emits their latest values together when either changes.
examples.output: The output is 20, then 30 after books changes.

examples.title: Keep only the latest waiting job
examples.description: switchMap switches to a new inner stream and unsubscribes from the previous one.
examples.output: After the wait, only garden is printed. The earlier timer was cancelled by the newer input.

examples.title: Handle a stream error
examples.description: catchError can replace a failed stream with another observable.
examples.output: The fallback emits an empty list, so the console shows 0.
